run_goaway_test: run the goaway test case to validate HTTP/2 GOAWAY frame handling with two sequential unary calls
run_rst_after_header_test: run the rst_after_header test case to validate RST_STREAM frame received after headers
run_rst_during_data_test: run the rst_during_data test case to validate RST_STREAM frame received during data transmission
run_max_streams_test: run the max_streams test case to validate server MAX_STREAMS setting with 15 concurrent requests
run_ping_test: run the ping test case to validate basic unary call response with compressable payload validation
